/products/abrasive-filament-brushes/.description: Abrasive filament brushes: wheel, cup and shank styles. Catalog radial wheels: 75–200 mm. Ask Frank to confirm grit for your workpiece.

/es/products/abrasive-filament-brushes/.description: Cepillos de filamento abrasivo: circulares, de copa o con vástago. Circulares de catálogo: 75–200 mm. Consulta a Frank sobre el grano.

/products/twisted-wire-wheels/.description: Twisted wire wheels: bevel brush with angled carbon steel knots, 4, 4.5 or 5 in. Typical wire: 0.5 mm. Ask Frank to confirm wire and mount.

/es/products/twisted-wire-wheels/.description: Discos de alambre trenzado de 4, 4.5 o 5 pulgadas, con haces inclinados de acero al carbono. Alambre típico: 0.5 mm. Consulta a Frank sobre el montaje.

/products/copper-coated-wire-wheels/.description: Copper-coated wire wheels for metal preparation. Typical wire: 0.3 mm. Ask Frank to confirm outside diameter, face width and mount.

/es/products/copper-coated-wire-wheels/.description: Discos de alambre de acero cobrizado para preparar metal. Alambre típico: 0.3 mm. Consulta a Frank sobre diámetro, ancho y montaje.

/products/banded-twisted-cup-brushes/.description: Banded twisted cup brushes with carbon steel knots, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4 or 5 in. Ask Frank to confirm the spindle thread for your order.

/es/products/banded-twisted-cup-brushes/.description: Copas trenzadas con aro de retención y acero al carbono, de 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4 o 5 pulgadas. Consulta a Frank para confirmar la rosca.

/products/crimped-wire-cup-brushes/.description: Crimped wire cup brushes for broad metal surfaces, 2.5, 3, 4, 5 or 6 in. Ask Frank to confirm wire material and thread for your size.

/es/products/crimped-wire-cup-brushes/.description: Copas de alambre ondulado para superficies metálicas, de 2.5, 3, 4, 5 o 6 pulgadas. Consulta a Frank sobre el material y la rosca.

/products/red-knotted-wire-cup-brush/.description: Red knotted wire cup brush with carbon steel knots, 2.5, 3, 4, 5 or 6 in. Ask Frank to confirm cup diameter and spindle thread.

/es/products/red-knotted-wire-cup-brush/.description: Copa roja de alambre trenzado de acero al carbono, de 2.5, 3, 4, 5 o 6 pulgadas. Consulta a Frank para confirmar diámetro y rosca.

/products/shaft-mounted-wire-wheels/.description: Shaft-mounted wire wheels, end and cup brushes. Ask Frank to match head shape, head diameter and shank diameter to the item you stock.

/es/products/shaft-mounted-wire-wheels/.description: Cepillos con vástago: de punta, circulares y de copa. Consulta a Frank para confirmar forma, diámetro del cabezal y medida del vástago.

/products/plastic-handle-hand-brushes/.description: Plastic-handle hand brushes for manual metal cleaning. Ask Frank to match your brush length and wire fill, or send a photo of your shelf item.

/es/products/plastic-handle-hand-brushes.description: Cepillos manuales con mango de plástico para limpiar metal. Consulta a Frank sobre largo y alambre, o envía una foto del modelo que vendes.

/products/wide-crimped-wire-wheels/.description: Wide crimped wire wheels, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 or 10 in. Typical wire: 0.3 mm. Ask Frank to confirm working width and center bore.

/es/products/wide-crimped-wire-wheels/.description: Discos anchos de alambre ondulado de 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 o 10 pulgadas. Alambre típico: 0.3 mm. Consulta a Frank sobre ancho y orificio.

/products/stringer-knotted-wheels/.description: Stringer knotted wheels with carbon steel knots for weld seams, 4.5, 5, 6 or 7 in. Ask Frank to confirm working width and mounting bore.

/es/products/stringer-knotted-wheels/.description: Discos trenzados de haces finos para cordones de soldadura, de 4.5, 5, 6 o 7 pulgadas. Consulta a Frank sobre ancho y orificio.

/es/products/twisted-wire-grass-trimmer-.description: Cabezales trenzados para desbrozadora: 6 pulgadas con 24 o 30 haces; 8 pulgadas con 30 o 36. Consulta a Frank sobre compatibilidad y montaje.
